candidates.draft_title: Add tailored content pathway for individual-contributor track
candidates.snippet:
[EXTERNAL] Bianca: Kind of you to say. Alright, second thing. This isn't a complaint, more a question. We're expanding the program in the fall — I want to add the individual-contributor track, not just managers. The high-potential ICs.
[EXTERNAL] Bianca: Maybe another 60, 70? It depends on budget, which depends on whether the summer line does what we hope.
[EXTERNAL] Bianca: Tailored, ideally. The reactive-dog stuff won't all land for people whose puppy just needs the basics.
[EXTERNAL] Bianca: Perfect. Send me the menu, I'll socialize it internally.
